record.issue_text: Email send failures in the addGuests handler are only console.log'd instead of using structured logging/alerting, making failed notifications invisible in production

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, the email notification send is wrapped in a try/catch that swallows all errors and only does `console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails")` (no error object, no rethrow). The handler still returns success (`{ message: "Guests added" }`) even if emails fail, making notification failures effectively silent/non-actionable in production unless console output is monitored. This is directly verifiable in the diff.
